<!-- Thank you for contributing to the Intent File Specification! -->

## What kind of change is this?

- [ ] **Editorial** — wording, typos, links, examples; no change to what a conforming file or generator must do
- [ ] **Specification** — new construct / attribute / semantics (link the discussion issue below)
- [ ] **Site** — theme, navigation, build

## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what changes and why. -->

## For specification changes

- Discussion issue: #
- [ ] The relevant chapter under `docs/spec/` is updated
- [ ] The DSL reference (`docs/reference.md`) is updated
- [ ] The text stays **vendor-neutral** (no product, runtime or package specifics)
- [ ] Normative rules are marked in a `::: info Normative` block

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run docs:build` passes locally
